name: guitarpulse
description: GuitarPulse: AI guitar improvisation app, shared music engine and Claude MCP connector

scripts.build: npm run build -w @guitarpulse/core && npm run build -w guitarpulse-mcp-server && npm run build -w @guitarpulse/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @guitarpulse/core && npm run test -w @guitarpulse/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @guitarpulse/core && npm run dev -w @guitarpulse/web
